description.zh:
指定要删除的服务器分组ID。
> 删除服务器分组，需要提供服务器分组ID，该ID可调用[DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the server group that you want to delete.
> To delete a server group, you must specify the server group ID. You can call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~) operation to obtain the server group ID.
The source IP address of the request.

descriptions.zh: 不支持删除云安全中心默认提供的服务器分组，即**未分组**。您删除某个分组后，该分组中的资产默认被移入**未分组**中。
descriptions.en: You cannot delete the default server group provided by Security Center, which is **Ungrouped**. After you delete a group, the assets in the group are moved to **Ungrouped** by default.
